tools.name: nsagent_suiteql
tools.description: Runs one read-only SuiteQL SELECT in NetSuite and returns up to 200 rows. SuiteQL is Oracle-flavoured: use ROWNUM, NVL, ||, TO_DATE('2026-01-31','YYYY-MM-DD') and BUILTIN.DF(field) for display values; no WITH/CTEs, LIMIT or OFFSET. Aggregate in SQL (COUNT(t.id), SUM) instead of fetching many rows. hasMore is true when more rows matched than were returned.

tools.name: nsagent_record_get
tools.description: Reads chosen fields of one NetSuite record by internal id, for example type customer, id 2815, fields 'id, companyname, email'. Use SuiteQL field ids (lowercase); nsagent_suiteql can find ids first.

type.description: SuiteQL record type, e.g. customer, transaction, vendor, item

fields.description: Comma-separated field ids to return, at most 50, e.g. 'id, companyname, email'
